_README: SCHEMA + EXAMPLE ONLY. The live watchlist is not published (see ../RESPONSIBLE-DISCLOSURE.md). Copy this to uncx-targets.json and fill in addresses for the contracts YOU are authorized to monitor. uncx_watch.py reads uncx-targets.example.json by default so the tool runs out-of-the-box against your own config.

_schema.incident: string - human label for the incident/contract family you are watching
_schema.targets: array of {chain, address, verified} - chain must be one of ethereum|base|bnb|robinhood (see CHAIN_SOURCES in uncx_watch.py); address = the VestingManager-style contract; verified = did you confirm code on-chain

incident: EXAMPLE: UNCX Network Vesting V2 accounting exploit (publicly disclosed 2026-10-14/15; Blockaid, ExVul, Rekt). Mechanism: createPosition -> release() -> donate -> cancel() double-counts shares. This entry documents the PUBLIC incident; the contract address is intentionally left as a placeholder.
